context: Checks the response applies the fallback table: temporary broad dependencies with a warning and migration plan, independent tasks without target defaults, and a main-branch base with documented trade-off.

checklist.name: No tags allows broad dependencies temporarily
checklist.description: The answer says that with no explicit tags broad dependencies are allowed only temporarily.

checklist.name: Warning is raised
checklist.description: The temporary allowance is accompanied by a warning rather than silence.

checklist.name: Migration plan is written
checklist.description: The answer includes a migration plan for tagging all twenty projects.

checklist.name: No targetDefaults means independent tasks
checklist.description: The answer states tasks run independently with reduced optimisation until `targetDefaults` exist.

checklist.name: targetDefaults configured for dependency flow
checklist.description: The answer adds `targetDefaults` with `dependsOn` for build, test and lint.

checklist.name: Missing base defaults to main
checklist.description: The answer says the base defaults to the main branch when no CI base or head is set.

checklist.name: Trade-off is documented
checklist.description: The answer states the base-branch trade-off must be written down.

checklist.name: Explicit base and head preferred
checklist.description: The target state uses an explicit base and head such as `--base=origin/main --head=HEAD`.

checklist.name: Shallow clone addressed
checklist.description: The answer recognises that a shallow checkout can break affected computation and asks for full history.

checklist.name: Tag vocabulary stays consistent
checklist.description: The tagging plan uses one defined vocabulary such as `scope:*` and `type:*`.
